steps.title: Section Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare kidney tissue sections using a cryostat.

substeps.instruction: Remove fresh frozen kidney sample from -80 °C storage and place in a cryostat set at -15 °C.
Mount the sample on a chuck using a minimal amount of water (one droplet).
Make 7 µm sections while maintaining a chuck temperature of -15 °C and a blade temperature of -20 °C (using Tissue-Tek Accu-Edge Disposable Microtome Blades, Sakura Finetek #4689).
Thaw-mount sections in sequential order onto either Conductive ITO Coating Glass Slides (Bruker #8237001) or Superfrost Plus Microscope Slides (Fischer Scientific #12-550-15).
Dry sections immediately after sectioning in the cryostat chamber.
Mark each slide with a number using a carbide pocket scriber.

steps.title: Store or Dry Mounted Slides
steps.instruction: Handle mounted slides based on the intended analysis timing.

substeps.instruction: For later imaging: Transfer ITO slides directly from the cryostat to a vacuum desiccator or 4 x 6 zipper bag and store at -80 °C. When retrieving, keep the bag closed for ~5 minutes to reach room temperature (RT) before opening.
For regular glass slides: Store at -80 °C until staining.
For immediate imaging: Place ITO slides in a vacuum desiccator at room temperature for 20 minutes to dry.
For stored slides: Place all slides (regular and ITO) from -80 °C in a vacuum desiccator to defrost.

steps.title: Perform Optical Co-registration
steps.instruction: Scan MALDI imaging slides for FTICR Mass Spectrometry co-registration.

substeps.instruction: Mount MALDI imaging slides in the Bruker MTP Slide Adapter II (#8235380).
Ensure visible fiducials (e.g., 'X' marks) are placed on the adapter as teaching points.
Scan with a flatbed scanner at a minimum of 3200 dpi resolution (output as JPEG, TIFF, or PNG).

steps.title: Prepare TM-Sprayer Hardware
steps.instruction: Initialize the TM-Sprayer unit and solvent systems.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the TM-Sprayer unit and set the valve to the LOAD position.
Start the solvent pump at 0.100 mL/min (expected backpressure ~500 psi / 3.4 MPa).
Start compressed air flow to the TM-Sprayer set at 10 psi (70 kPA).
Adjust the operating temperature on the sprayer device based on the solvent mixture (mixture must contain minimum 30% water).

steps.title: Prepare Matrix Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the matrix solution (typical concentration 5 mg/mL) based on the ion mode.

substeps.instruction: Positive ion mode (DHB): 40 mg/mL DHB in 1:1 MeOH:Water; set sprayer to 80 °C, 3 mm/track spacing, 8 cycles, 1200 mm/min velocity, 0.05 mL/min flow.

Positive ion mode (DAN): 4.4 mg/mL DAN in 9 mL of 1:1 Ethanol:Water (prepared by adding 500 µL of 1M HCl to 4 mL milli'Q' water and 4.5 mL ethanol); set sprayer to 90 °C, 3 mm/track spacing, 16 cycles, 1250 mm/min velocity, 0.05 mL/min flow.
Negative ion mode (NEDC): 7 mg/mL NEDC in 7:3 Methanol:Water; set sprayer to 70 °C, 3 mm/track spacing, 8 passes, 1200 mm/min velocity, 0.12 mL/min flow.

Negative ion mode (DAN): 4.4 mg/mL DAN in 9 mL of 1:1 Ethanol:Water (prepared by adding 500 µL of 1M HCl to 4 mL milli'Q' water and 4.5 mL ethanol); set sprayer to 90 °C, 3 mm/track spacing, 16 cycles, 1250 mm/min velocity, 0.05 mL/min flow.

steps.title: Apply Matrix to Tissue
steps.instruction: Load and spray the matrix onto the ITO slides.

substeps.instruction: With the valve in LOAD position, use a syringe to fill the loop with matrix (20% overfill recommended, e.g., 6 mL syringe for 5 mL loop).
Retrieve the ITO glass slide with sample from the desiccator.
Verify solvent pump flow rate and spray nozzle temperature are stable.
Define the spraying area in the TM-Sprayer software and select the Method.
Press START and, when prompted, switch the valve to Spray and click Continue.
Allow the nozzle to automatically move to the Waste position at the end of the run.

steps.title: Clean and Shutdown TM-Sprayer
steps.instruction: Flush the system to prevent matrix crystallization and clogging.

substeps.instruction: Switch the valve back to LOAD; keep the solvent pump flow on.
Spray at 0.200 mL/min for 10 minutes, then at 0.010 mL/min until ready to resume.
Switch valve to LOAD and set solvent pump flow rate to 0.500 mL/min.
Set temperature to 30 °C to begin cool down.
Fill a syringe with 5-6 mL of clean solvent and flush the loop completely 3 times.
Toggle the valve to wash matrix residue, then leave in LOAD position.
Maintain airflow and solvent pump flow until the temperature is below 50 °C.
Turn off N2 flow.

steps.title: Extract Lipids from Remaining Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform a chloroform-methanol extraction on the remaining frozen biopsy sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 200-300 µL of MilliQ water to the remaining fresh frozen biopsy sample in a tube and lyse using a tissue lyser; record tissue weight.
Transfer the sample to a 2 mL Sorenson MµlTI™ SafeSeal™ Microcentrifuge Tube (VWR #53550).
Add cold (-20 °C) chloroform:methanol mix (2:1 v/v) at a 4:1 ratio relative to sample volume (e.g., 400 μl mix to 80 μl sample) and vortex for 5-10 seconds.
Centrifuge the sample at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully remove and discard the upper aqueous metabolite layer without disturbing the protein disk.
Puncture the protein interphase with a pipette tip and transfer the bottom organic lipid phase into a conical bottom Waters autosampler vial, ensuring no protein or methanol phase is transferred.
Place the organic layer in a speed vac to dry.
